gaia.query:
SELECT source_id, ra, dec, pmra, pmdec, parallax, phot_g_mean_mag
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source
WHERE phot_g_mean_mag < 12 AND parallax > 10 AND parallax_over_error > 10 (in 4 RA chunks)
gaia.note: anonymous async results capped at 50,000 rows without error; chunk and check COUNT(*)

wise.access: pyvo TAP async with TAP_UPLOAD (irsa.ipac.caltech.edu/TAP), table allwise_p3as_psd
wise.query:
SELECT u.source_id, a.designation, a.w1mpro, a.w2mpro, a.w3mpro, a.w4mpro, a.cc_flags, a.ext_flg,
       DISTANCE(POINT('ICRS', u.ra_w, u.dec_w), POINT('ICRS', a.ra, a.dec)) AS sep_deg
FROM allwise_p3as_psd a, TAP_UPLOAD.gaia u
WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', a.ra, a.dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', u.ra_w, u.dec_w, 0.0008333333333333334))=1
wise.note: IRSA DISTANCE() returns arcsec, not degrees (verified with a 1-arcsec offset); upload cross-match of 60k positions took 18 min, Gaia's precomputed allwise_best_neighbour 3 s. Positional 3-arcsec match finds 59,603 vs 53,525 in allwise_best_neighbour (stricter one-to-one quality cut).

tess.access: MAST S3 mirror s3://stpubdata/tess/public/tid/ (unsigned), read with lightkurve

exoplanets.query:
SELECT pl_name, hostname, pl_eqt, pl_rade, pl_bmasse, sy_dist, discoverymethod
FROM pscomppars
WHERE pl_eqt >= 200 AND pl_eqt <= 350
ORDER BY pl_eqt
